description: China's RMB central parity (人民币汇率中间价), the daily USD/CNY fixing the PBOC publishes at 09:15 Beijing time, for a named date or the latest: USD/CNY by default, or any published pair (EUR/CNY, 100JPY/CNY, HKD/CNY, GBP/CNY and more, or `all`), with an optional history window. Answers "USD/CNY central parity today", "what was the PBOC fixing on 2026-11-06", "RMB midpoint history". A weekend or holiday date returns found:false with reason no_fixing_for_date and the nearest earlier fixing. Keyless, sourced live from the China Foreign Exchange Trade System.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD (Beijing). Omit for the latest published fixing.

history_days.description: Also return the fixings for this many calendar days up to the date, 0-366 (default 0).

pair.description: Currency pair such as "USD/CNY" (default), "EUR/CNY", "100JPY/CNY", "CNY/KRW", or "all" for every published pair.

name: china_rmb_fixing

nearest_earlier.description: nearest earlier fixing when the requested date had none

title: China Rmb Fixing
